name: rw_rowboat
subject: a small wooden rowing boat with a grown man rowing it, seen exactly from the side, the bow to the left: a varnished brown wooden hull with a lighter gunwale and a white stripe, a grown man in a navy coat and a red knitted cap sitting on the middle thwart facing the stern, both hands on the oars, one oar blade dipping into the water
part_map: the brown shape is the hull (exactly that length; its top edge is the flat gunwale the dog will stand on), the grey block the rower's body, the light circle his head, the thin brown line an oar.
size_sentence: the boat is three times as long as the dog; the seated rower's head is higher than the dog's head. A real rowing boat and a grown man.
